fixture.scope: All rows in the seven declared load-fixture tables in the synthetic workspace; excludes authentication/session and audit activity generated by login. No reset, repair, reseed or inferred whole-database equality.

limits: Single browser, one fresh context per viewport, no network emulation. Header flags classify requests; no full headers/cookies/query values/body captured. Required content/readiness preserved. One-second post-ready observation is explicit. Counts are this bounded observation, not ten-user performance or all possible future navigation. No app behavior or cache policy changed.
